scelus

scelus, sceleris n.

noun, third declension

a crime, a wicked deed

In this lexicon

  • crime

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.5.170; Cic. Cat. 2.27; Traupman 194

Examples

  • Facinus est vincīre cīvem Rōmānum, scelus verberāre, prope parricīdium necāre

    It is a crime to bind a Roman citizen, a wickedness to flog him, almost parricide to kill himCic. Verr. 2.5.170
